    Information

    [edit]

    Format

    [edit]
    • Regional Winners Seeding:
      • Comprised of the four regional winners
      • Double elimination bracket
      • All matches are Ft3
      • All four teams advance to Playoffs
    • Group Stage:
      • Comprised of the four other CECC qualifier winners and 12 partner qualifier winners
      • Four GSL groups
      • All matches are Ft3
      • Top two teams from each group advance to Playoffs
    • Playoffs:
      • Single elimination bracket
      • All matches are Ft3

    Broadcast Talent

    [edit]
    • Hosts:
      •  Herculyse (Elyse Herrera)
      •  Los (Carlos Braadt)
      •  Septilence (Mathew Corfee II)
    • Commentators:
      •  ClutchKey (Keegan Ohta)
      •  Twinsalty (Jesse Brawders)
